title: Tip 5: Resist Easy Redemption
use_cases: Use when drafting characters that exist between traditional hero and villain archetypes
Implement when developing a character's internal logic to justify ethically questionable actions
Configure when establishing a character's specific moral code and boundaries they will not cross
Use when distinguishing between an anti-hero protagonist and a broader morally gray character
Implement when using a character's backstory to create reader empathy for controversial decisions
